continuous_boundary_followup_20260929.purpose: Separate boundary representation sensitivity from evaluation-length sensitivity in continuous-residual neural policy iteration.
continuous_boundary_followup_20260929.status: Prespecified follow-up using previously inspected seeds; no independent-replication or runtime superiority claim.
primary_comparisons: frozen: step1000 minus step50 within each representation
frozen: relaxed minus full at step1000
iteration: relaxed minus full at step2000
continuous_boundary_followup_20260929.multiplicity: Bonferroni across 24 primary seedwise comparisons (12 evaluation-length, 6 frozen-representation, 6 repeated-iteration); other steps descriptive.
continuous_boundary_followup_20260929.interpretation: Frozen comparisons have exactly the same initial value function and frozen policy, using a fixed base plus an equally sized trainable correction. Repeated iteration starts both representations at the same terminal utility and retains Adam state between policy updates. Relaxing a boundary changes interior parameterization as well as trace restrictions. Neither comparison alone identifies a boundary-only causal effect. The 2000-step iteration is an early-budget test, not a replacement for the earlier 10000-step solver comparison.

derivative_curves_20260929.qualification: Finite-difference estimates of errors relative to two rounded-policy finite references. Mesh difference is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a rigorous error bound. All saved checkpoints and all three previously inspected seeds are included.

fixed_policy_accuracy_20260926.optimizer: fresh Adam, identical state for all saved prefixes
fixed_policy_accuracy_20260926.lr_schedule: cosine in absolute step 200+j with T_max=10000, independent of selected inner budget
fixed_policy_accuracy_20260926.status: development intervention; three previously inspected training seeds; no speed claim

npi_evaluation_controls_20260929.inference: Diagnostic reuse of inspected seeds. Bonferroni 24 seedwise length contrasts; other contrasts descriptive.
npi_evaluation_controls_20260929.damping_rule: min(1,RMS_core(p50-q)/RMS_core(p1000-q)); fixed 546 points, no CE tuning
npi_evaluation_controls_20260929.damping_inference: Three damped-minus-short contrasts, Bonferroni 3; conditional MC intervals only.
npi_evaluation_controls_20260929.decomposition: Exact interior quotient identity; both finite references; steps 0, 50, 1000; cross terms retained.

npi_focused_strengthening_20260926.status: Protocol fixed locally before new outcomes; not externally preregistered

finite.initial_function: same saved 200-step continuous evaluator; add zero-initialized correction
finite.frozen_policy: same saved 200-step feedback, interpolated then rounded to nearest action
finite.operator: bounded positive generator with identical stopped boundary sources
finite.proposal: exact discrete greedy action, lower index at ties

analysis.main_event: full evaluation RMS decreases from 50 to 1000 while proposal CE decreases
analysis.monte_carlo_intervals: paired conditional 95% and Bonferroni-adjusted across all 18 continuous contrasts; discretization bias excluded
analysis.independence: six new initialization/optimization seed blocks reused across three scenarios, not eighteen independent seed blocks
analysis.finite_comparison_scope: within each fixed discretization; lower-wealth trace constraint is relaxed without changing assigned exit payoff

npi_iteration_diagnostic_20260926.kind: exploratory diagnosis, no algorithm or model change
npi_iteration_diagnostic_20260926.intervals: pointwise paired Monte Carlo; no selection or simultaneous guarantee
npi_iteration_diagnostic_20260926.scope: One original stopped model; existing 10-seed findings already seen. Three replays are not additional independent training seeds. Fixed-budget replay with extra saving, not wall-time evidence.

npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.purpose: Connect matched CPU performance contrasts to derivative combinations on the same frozen policies.
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.status: Locally specified before these derivative outcomes; reuse of inspected training seeds; diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.generator: bounded positive wide stencil; backward Euler; nearest discrete action with lower index at ties
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.reference_policy: CPU greedy of shared initial function, tabulated once and shared by both evaluation designs and reference grids
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.mask: For each seed, common intersection over both meshes, both representations and all four steps: positive curvatures and interior greedy actions. Also report all-point clipped action error and mask counts.
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.statistics: Three quotient component RMS values, all cross terms, combined error, combined/component RMS ratio, update RMS and eta/S RMS. Report every seed; no expected direction imposed.
npi_matched_derivatives_20260929.scope: Deterministic finite-reference diagnostics. Core error norms do not identify CE changes or the optimizer mechanism. Mesh differences are sensitivity measures, not bounds. No new training or CE-based selection.

training.status: fixed-protocol study; final checkpoint; no reference-based selection

npi_walltime_20260926.status: prospective small comparison, new seeds; thresholds fixed without tuning on these seeds; directional proxy not certified
npi_walltime_20260926.schedule: cosine by elapsed fraction of 30 seconds, same for all methods
npi_walltime_20260926.timing: sequential GPU runs, no simultaneous audit jobs; 50-step polling; CPU serialization charged; post-training MC excluded for all methods
npi_walltime_20260926.target_scope: first saved checkpoint with estimated CE gain >=10 bp over myopic; noisy post-hoc measurement, not online stopping

npi_walltime_audit_20260926.scope: Post-training audit: 480-step curves and 960-step endpoint refinement, chosen before audit outcomes; common random paths, no online selection
